horizon.friends.title: E pāʻani me nā hoa
horizon.friends.hint: Hoʻopili nā hoa i ke code ma hope o ke pihi Hoa o ka pale poʻo inoa, ma Direct Connection, a i ʻole ma ka ʻaoʻao Play o ka mea hoʻolaha.
horizon.friends.share_intro: E kaʻana like i kēia ao ma hope o kahi code kono: wehe ia i LAN, a hui pū nā hoaaloha ma ka pūnaewele me ke code. ʻAʻohe kikowaena o kā mākou pili.
horizon.friends.stopped: Ua ho'ōki i ka hāʻawi ʻana i ke code kono.
horizon.friends.short_code_changed: Ke hoʻāʻo nei kekahi i kahi code pōkole hewa, no laila ua loli.
horizon.friends.wrong_code: Ua hoʻāʻo kekahi i kahi code hewa.
horizon.friends.relay_stopped: Nui loa nā code pōkole hewa, no laila ua paʻa ka relay a hiki i kou kaʻana hou ʻana. Hiki nō i nā hoaaloha ke hui me ka code piha.
horizon.friends.code_ready: Ua mākaukau kāu code kono: Game Menu, Play with Friends. E kope a hoʻouna aku i kāu mau hoaaloha.
horizon.friends.share_failed: ʻAʻole hiki ke kaʻana like i ka honua: %s
horizon.friends.finding_route: Ke ʻimi nei pehea e hiki ai i nā hoaaloha ke loaʻa iā ʻoe…
horizon.multiplayer.finding_friend: Ke ʻimi nei i ka honua o kāu hoaaloha...
horizon.multiplayer.connected_friend_dir: Hoʻopili pololei ʻia i kāu hoaaloha...
